costs.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32, one arm per device

alternative_explanations: Near misses are real small gains
Data order or dropout noise dominates init noise
K1 is capacity or data limited so noise is irrelevant
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: D<1 meV and E<1.5 meV falsifies noise/variance as the cause of null screens.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: E < 1.5 meV: same-architecture ensembling has low value at 100K. Falsifier: if D < 1 meV and E < 1.5 meV, the explanation that noise and variance hide gains is wrong, and the limit is capacity, data or contract. Close the init-noise question without retry, continuation, 500K, full training or adoption.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Spread D = max pairwise |MAE difference| among the s42 mean, s43 and s44. D <= 1.0 meV: init noise is small; the past 2-3 meV near misses (typed pair token 2.80, combined simplification 2.16) deserve a 2-init confirmation. 1.0 < D < 2.5 meV: keep the 3 meV gate; any confirmation needs 2 inits per arm. D >= 2.5 meV: single-seed 3 meV screens are underpowered; past near misses become unresolved, not positive, and future screens need >=2 inits per arm. Ensemble gain E = MAE of the 3-init mean prediction against the mean single-run MAE, from saved 50K dev predictions. E >= 3 meV: ensembling beats every module tried and becomes the leading 500K/full candidate for the owner to decide. Rerun drift R = |ref_s42(A) - ref_s42(B)|; R > 0.5 meV means hardware nondeterminism is material. If only one kernel finishes, report one |delta| as a single noise sample and apply no D threshold. No automatic adoption or scale-up.
hypothesis.observed_deficiency: Every K1 100K screen uses one seed, so the 1-3 meV near misses cannot be separated from initialization noise; no multi-seed 100K K1 result exists (the only attempt, seed 43, ended NO_TRAIN).

trajectory.question: How much does K1 post-BN 100K dev MAE change with the initial weights alone (torch seed 44 against the frozen seed 42), and what does a 3-init mean prediction gain over a single run?
